name: lapviz
description: Read your lap timing sessions on lapviz.com: lap and sector times, time per corner, progress, setups and circuit leaderboards.

interface.longDescription:
LapViz keeps the lap timing sessions of drivers (karting, cars, motorbikes) recorded by data loggers, lap timers and phones. Connect your LapViz account and ask about your sessions in plain words: where you lost time in a session, corner by corner against your best lap or a reference lap; your lap and sector times, ideal lap and consistency; your progress per circuit; your best setups per conditions; the public leaderboard of a circuit and your place in it.

The connector only reads, with your access rights: your own sessions, those shared with you and those of the drivers you coach. It returns summaries (times, speeds, braking), never the raw telemetry files, and it changes nothing in your account.

You need a LapViz account with sessions: import the files of your logger or lap timer on lapviz.com, or record them with the LapViz app.
defaultPrompt: Where did I lose time in my last session?
How much did I progress this season?
Compare my best lap with the circuit record

positive.description: Find the latest sessions of the user
positive.prompt: List my last five driving sessions with the circuit and my best lap.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to five sessions of the demo account, newest first, each with its circuit, date and best lap time.

positive.description: Analyse where time is lost in a session
positive.prompt: Where did I lose time on my best lap of my last session at Genk, compared with my second best lap?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest Genk session and gives the time gained or lost per corner, with apex and exit speeds and braking, between the best and second best laps.

positive.prompt: Summarise my last session: best lap, ideal lap, consistency and weather.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the latest session and reports its best lap, ideal lap, consistency, sector times and weather.

positive.prompt: How much have I progressed on each circuit this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the circuits of the demo account with the first best lap, the personal best and the time gained.

positive.prompt: Show the leaderboard of Karting Genk and where I rank.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the public leaderboard of the Genk circuit, the records per category and the place of the demo account.
